title: Stellar Protocol Canary fixture inventory, inventoryVersion 1
description: The `stellar-canary fixtures --format json` document (CA-02). Required fields follow CA-02 section 3. An absent optional field means the fixture file did not carry it, never a default and never null. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know: inventoryVersion 1 only grows additively, and this schema therefore sets no `additionalProperties: false`. The closed sets are `surface`, the documented capability spellings, and the verification method and outcome.

inventoryVersion.description: The inventory document version. This schema validates version 1 only.

toolVersion.description: The Canary CLI's own semver. Informational; never use it for feature detection.

fixtureFormat.description: The fixture file format the engine reads. 1 today.

protocol.description: The protocol this inventory lists: --protocol, else the configuration file, else 28.

directoryFound.description: Whether --fixtures-dir exists as a directory. false is a successful empty answer, not an error.

counts.description: How many fixtures of `protocol` the directory holds, by surface. total is xdr + rpc + soroban.

otherProtocols.description: Fixtures in the directory for every protocol other than `protocol`. Keys are the protocol number as a decimal string, values are counts. {} when there are none.

fixtures.description: One entry per fixture of `protocol`, sorted by id comparing UTF-8 bytes.

id.description: The fixture identity. Unique across the directory.

surface.description: Closed set. Adding a value is a breaking inventoryVersion change.

category.description: From the fixture file. Untrusted text; never render as markup.

description.description: From the fixture file. Untrusted text; never render as markup.

path.description: Fixture file path relative to --fixtures-dir, `/` separators, never absolute and never containing `..`.

requiredCapabilities.description: Sorted, lowercase kebab. [] when the file lists none.

sourceReference.description: The file's source_reference. Omitted, not null, when the file has none.

method.description: RPC fixtures: the RPC method name.

type.description: XDR fixtures: the XDR type name.

kind.description: XDR fixtures: decode-success, roundtrip, and the other documented kinds.

function.description: Soroban fixtures: the contract function name.

verification.description: The CF-04 record copied as stored. Absent when the fixture has no record.

fixtureSha256.description: Reserved until CF-02. Lowercase hex when present.
